instruction: Change the line spacing of all body paragraphs (excluding title and references) to double spacing (2.0).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing line spacing of body paragraphs to double spacing (2.0). The evaluator checks the line spacing value of a sample body paragraph and verifies it is 2.0 (with 0.1 tolerance).

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL - Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires changing 'ALL body paragraphs' but getter only checks the FIRST body paragraph (line 45 in getter)
User could change only the first paragraph to 2.0 and pass, leaving all other paragraphs unchanged
Getter limits body paragraphs to indices 2-9 (line 38: 'i < 10'), which is arbitrary and may miss many body paragraphs in longer documents
Instruction says 'excluding title and references' but getter only excludes first 2 paragraphs, doesn't identify or exclude reference sections at the end
Metric logic is correct for comparing values with tolerance, but receives incomplete data from getter
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should iterate through ALL body paragraphs and check that each one has line spacing 2.0, not just the first one
Remove the 'i < 10' limit and check all paragraphs between title and references sections
Implement logic to identify and exclude reference section (e.g., paragraphs after 'References' heading)
Return a summary showing how many paragraphs were checked and how many passed, or return list of all line spacing values
Metric should verify that ALL body paragraphs have correct spacing, not just one sample
